sources.title: Lion programs run for the CIRT research after the schema self-reference fix, at commit 5b36704

claims.where: program ci-negative-recursion.json: a schema whose predicate says the value does not fit that same schema
claims.quote: Whether 1 fits "Bad" has no answer: checking it asks the same question again, and the value would fit exactly when it does not.

says.lion: recursive schemas whose every check ends

claims.where: program ci-positive-through-lambda.json: a schema whose predicate asks whether the value fits that same schema
claims.quote: "1 fits a schema whose predicate asks whether the value fits that same schema": false

says.lion: recursive schemas whose every check ends

claims.where: program ci-stratified-recursion.json: EvenList asks under not whether the list's tail fits EvenList
claims.quote: "a list of three fits EvenList": false

says.lion: schemas that recurse through not on a smaller part of the value

claims.quote: "a string fits a schema that names itself before value/integer?": false

says.lion: recursive schemas read as least fixed points

claims.quote: Adding this fact breaks an invariant, so nothing changed.

says.lion: schema checks that never change the value they check

claims.quote: "every integer is a number, and value/integer? fits value/number?": false

says.lion: a check of whether one schema includes another

claims.quote: "two lambdas with the same text are equal": false

says.lion: a way to compare what two predicates accept

claims.quote: "two lambdas with the same text are equal": false

claims.where: program ci-rule-negation.json: win(x) if a move from x reaches a position that does not win
claims.quote: Rule ["rule",["win","?x"],["move","?x","?y"],["not",["win","?y"]]] asks about "win", which depends on "win". A question, such as a goal under "not", cannot go through recursion.

says.lion: rules that recurse through not on a smaller argument

claims.quote: A question, such as a goal under "not", cannot go through recursion.

says.lion: rules refused when a question goes through recursion

claims.where: program ci-rule-shrinking.json: each suffix of a word, by array/tail
claims.quote: computes a new value in its head while recursing, which may never finish.

says.lion: rules that recurse on a smaller value they compute

claims.where: program ci-larger-value.json: a schema whose lambda asks about a list that holds the value
claims.quote: A schema may ask about itself again only about a smaller value, so that its check ends.

says.lion: recursive schemas whose every check ends
